lines.text: The LORD says He is the first and the last, and His own hand founded the earth.
The LORD's chosen ally will carry out His desire against Nineveh, and he will succeed in his mission.
The LORD directs Israel in the way to go, and says obedience would have made their peace like a river.
Israel's descendants would have been countless as the sand, and the LORD has redeemed His servant Moses.
The LORD made water gush from the split rock in the deserts, and says the wicked have no peace.
